chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad informed me, from his father, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from al-Haytham ibn Abī Masrūq al-Nahdī, from Marwak ibn ʿUbayd, from Nashīṭ ibn Ṣāliḥ, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him how much water suffices for cleansing after urination, and he said: “Twice the amount of the moisture that is upon the glans.”

key_terms.يُجْزِي: is sufficient or adequate for fulfilling the requirement
key_terms.ٱلِاسْتِنْجَاءِ: cleansing the private part after relieving oneself
key_terms.ٱلْبَوْلِ: urine; here, the cause requiring cleansing
key_terms.ٱلْحَشَفَةِ: the glans of the private part

ai.seo_question: How much water is sufficient for istinja' after urination according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding istinja' after urination, specifying the amount of water that is sufficient. It belongs to the rulings of taharah and reflects the precision of the Imams عليهم السلام in teaching practical acts of ritual purity.
